reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS month,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'paid') AS paid,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'uncollectible') AS uncollectible,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS open
FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', invoice_date) AS DATE)
alternatives:
SELECT month, paid, uncollectible, "open" AS open
FROM (
  -- one row per invoice of 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS month, status
  FROM invoices
  WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
) AS i
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR status IN ('paid', 'uncollectible', 'open') GROUP BY month)

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'uncollectible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uncollectible,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open
FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', invoice_date) AS DATE)
